name: Lea
author: Erin Carter
description: A meadow seen from directly above: a jittered grid of short grass-tuft strokes that lie near-black and almost still until an aperiodic gust band sweeps across, stretching and combing the tufts downwind so their far tips brighten — a travelling front of glowing dashes with calm dark meadow on either side.

params.label: Tuft spacing
params.effect: CSS-pixel spacing of the tuft grid, from dense turf to scattered tussocks.

params.label: Gust rate
params.effect: How often gust bands cross the meadow.

params.label: Lean
params.effect: How far the tufts stretch downwind inside a passing band.

params.label: Tip glow
params.effect: Brightness of the leaning tips, controlling how vividly a front reads against the calm.
